item.text: I’m re-reading the current source and file layout before changing anything. The useful next refactor here is likely to separate the solver API from the command-line entrypoint and stop recomputing the DP state for different queries.

I’m splitting the solver and result into dedicated types so the entrypoint becomes a thin facade over one computation path.
I’ve reduced the entrypoint to validation plus delegation. Next I’m adding the dedicated solver and immutable result types so the DP state lives behind a reusable API instead of inside the CLI class.
